title: Jasper vs Runway
description: Jasper vs Runway: Runway is our overall pick for AI & Machine Learning teams — Jasper 4.4/5, Runway 4.5/5; Jasper from $69/mo (Pro) – custom.
verdict: Runway emerges as the winner in this comparison based on overall feature depth, user satisfaction ratings, and value for money in the AI & Machine Learning category. While both platforms are strong contenders, Runway offers the better balance of features, pricing, and user experience for most use cases.

faqs.question: Which is better for small teams, Jasper or Runway?
faqs.answer: For small teams, the choice often comes down to ease of setup and pricing. Jasper tends to be more intuitive for new users, while Runway offers more advanced features that smaller teams may not need immediately. Consider your team's technical comfort level and growth plans.

faqs.question: Can Jasper and Runway be integrated?
faqs.answer: Both platforms offer API access and integration capabilities, making it possible to use them together if needed. However, most teams find it more efficient to standardize on one platform to avoid data duplication and workflow fragmentation.
